_rationale: 88 rolling 10-yr windows of 60/40 history with no withdrawals. The simulation reports balances in today's dollars, so the displayed final balance is the REAL (CPI-deflated) outcome of each window. Historical 60/40 real CAGR is roughly 5% over most multi-decade windows; the median real outcome from $500k after 9 years of growth (path[lifeExp - currentAge - 1] is reported BEFORE the last year's growth) lands in a wide but well-bounded band. probability=100 because zero spending cannot deplete a balance.
